root.command: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.SystemPreferencesHdrTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.SystemPreferencesHdrTbl ( PrefsID INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_SystemPreferencesHdrTbl PRIMARY KEY, WooCommerceEnabled BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_SysPrefs_WooEnabled DEFAULT (0), WooWizardCompleted BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_SysPrefs_WooWizard DEFAULT (0), UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NULL, UpdatedBy NVARCHAR(100) NULL ); INSERT INTO dbo.SystemPreferencesHdrTbl (PrefsID, WooCommerceEnabled, WooWizardCompleted, UpdatedAt, UpdatedBy) VALUES (1, 0, 0, SYSUTCDATETIME(), N'seed'); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl ( SettingsID INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooCommerceSettingsTbl PRIMARY KEY, StoreBaseUrl NVARCHAR(500) NULL, AdminBaseUrl NVARCHAR(500) NULL, ConsumerKeyEncrypted NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL, ConsumerSecretEncrypted NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL, IntegrationEnabled BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSet_Enabled DEFAULT (0), WizardCompleted BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSet_Wizard DEFAULT (0), LastConnectionTestUtc DATETIME2 NULL, LastConnectionTestOk BIT NULL, LastItemsSyncUtc DATETIME2 NULL, LastOrdersSyncUtc DATETIME2 NULL, LastOrdersSyncOrderNumber NVARCHAR(50) NULL, LastContactsSyncUtc DATETIME2 NULL, PushEnabledStateToWoo BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSet_PushEnabled DEFAULT (1), DisableScopeDefault NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSet_DisableScope DEFAULT (N'MappedOnly'), PullStockQtyEnabled BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSet_PullQty DEFAULT (0), CategoryFilterMode NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSet_CatMode DEFAULT (N'All'), GuestCheckoutContactMode NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSet_Guest DEFAULT (N'ZZName'), DispatchDeliveryPersonIds NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSet_DispatchIds DEFAULT (N'5,7'), TrackingNumberRequired BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSet_TrackReq DEFAULT (1), DispatchedWooStatus NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSet_DispStatus DEFAULT (N'processing'), AutoCompleteOnWooCompleted BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooSet_AutoDone DEFAULT (0), UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NULL, UpdatedBy NVARCHAR(100) NULL ); INSERT INTO dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl (SettingsID, IntegrationEnabled, WizardCompleted, UpdatedAt, UpdatedBy) VALUES (1, 0, 0, SYSUTCDATETIME(), N'seed'); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooCategoryFilterTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooCategoryFilterTbl ( FilterID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooCategoryFilterTbl PRIMARY KEY, WooCategoryId BIGINT NOT NULL, CategoryName NVARCHAR(255) NULL, ParentWooCategoryId BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooCat_Parent DEFAULT (0), IncludeInSync BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooCat_Include DEFAULT (1), CONSTRAINT UQ_WooCategoryFilter_WooCategoryId UNIQUE (WooCategoryId) ); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooCategoryFilterTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooCategoryFilterTbl', N'ParentWooCategoryId') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooCategoryFilterTbl ADD ParentWooCategoryId BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooCat_Parent DEFAULT (0); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooItemMappingsTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooItemMappingsTbl ( MappingID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooItemMappingsTbl PRIMARY KEY, ItemID INT NOT NULL, WooProductId BIGINT NULL, WooVariationId BIGINT NULL, MapType NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooMap_Type DEFAULT (N'Exact'), SkuPattern NVARCHAR(255) NULL, QtyFactor FLOAT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooMap_Qty DEFAULT (1), PackagingID INT NULL, DisableScope NVARCHAR(50) NULL, LastSyncedUtc DATETIME2 NULL, LastWooStatus NVARCHAR(50) NULL, IsActive BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooMap_Active DEFAULT (1) ); CREATE INDEX IX_WooItemMappings_ItemID ON dbo.WooItemMappingsTbl (ItemID); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooSkuWildcardRulesTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooSkuWildcardRulesTbl ( RuleID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooSkuWildcardRulesTbl PRIMARY KEY, SkuPrefixPattern NVARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, SuffixToken NVARCHAR(50) NULL, QtyFactor FLOAT NOT NULL, PackagingID INT NULL, ItemID INT NOT NULL, IsActive BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooWild_Active DEFAULT (1), Notes NVARCHAR(255) NULL ); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooOrderInfoTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooOrderInfoTbl ( OrderID BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooOrderInfoTbl PRIMARY KEY, WooOrderId BIGINT NOT NULL, WooOrderNumber NVARCHAR(50) NULL, WooStatus NVARCHAR(50) NULL, PaymentMethod NVARCHAR(100) NULL, PaymentStatus NVARCHAR(50) NULL, PaymentPaid BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooOrd_Paid DEFAULT (0), TrackingNumber NVARCHAR(100) NULL, LastSyncedUtc DATETIME2 NULL, RawSnapshotJson NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL, CONSTRAINT UQ_WooOrderInfo_WooOrderId UNIQUE (WooOrderId) ); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooContactInfoTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooContactInfoTbl ( ContactID BIGINT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooContactInfoTbl PRIMARY KEY, WooCustomerId BIGINT NULL, MatchEmail NVARCHAR(255) NULL, LastSyncedUtc DATETIME2 NULL ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_WooContactInfo_WooCustomerId ON dbo.WooContactInfoTbl (WooCustomerId) WHERE WooCustomerId IS NOT NULL; END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooImportBatchesTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooImportBatchesTbl ( BatchID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooImportBatchesTbl PRIMARY KEY, BatchType NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, Status NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, CreatedUtc DATETIME2 NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooBatch_Created DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()), ConfirmedUtc DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy NVARCHAR(100) NULL, Notes NVARCHAR(500) NULL ); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooImportBatchLinesTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooImportBatchLinesTbl ( BatchLineID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooImportBatchLinesTbl PRIMARY KEY, BatchID INT NOT NULL, ExternalId NVARCHAR(50) NULL, PreviewJson NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL, MatchStatus NVARCHAR(50) NULL, IsSelected BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooBatchLine_Sel DEFAULT (1), ImportResult NVARCHAR(50) NULL, TrackerEntityId BIGINT NULL ); CREATE INDEX IX_WooImportBatchLines_BatchID ON dbo.WooImportBatchLinesTbl (BatchID); END

SELECT name FROM sys.tables WHERE name IN ( N'SystemPreferencesHdrTbl', N'WooCommerceSettingsTbl', N'WooCategoryFilterTbl', N'WooItemMappingsTbl', N'WooSkuWildcardRulesTbl', N'WooOrderInfoTbl', N'WooContactInfoTbl', N'WooImportBatchesTbl', N'WooImportBatchLinesTbl' ) ORDER BY name;
